hero.role: Medical Student | Aspiring Physician | Research Enthusiast
hero.intro: Building a future in medicine through knowledge, compassion and continuous learning.

paragraphs: I am Gaurav Singh, a final-year MBBS student at Kathmandu Medical College, Nepal. My journey in medicine is shaped by curiosity for clinical science, appreciation for evidence-based practice and a commitment to continuous learning.
My interests span cardiovascular medicine, research, antimicrobial resistance, public health, medical education and healthcare innovation.
